title: Multiple RNA- and DNA-binding proteins exhibit direct transfer of polynucleotides with implications for target-site search.
authors: Hemphill, Wayne O; Voong, Calvin K; Fenske, Regan; Goodrich, James A; Cech, Thomas R
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
one_liner_zh: 该文通过荧光偏振和单分子实验证明多种RNA/DNA结合蛋白可直接在核酸间转移，涉及靶位点搜索机制，虽非TF-DNA体系且以实验为主，但对蛋白-核酸互作动态机制有借鉴意义。
abstract: We previously demonstrated that the polycomb repressive complex 2 chromatin-modifying enzyme can directly transfer between RNA and DNA without a free-enzyme intermediate state. Simulations suggested that such a direct transfer mechanism may be generally necessary for RNA to recruit proteins to chromatin, but the prevalence of direct transfer capability is unknown. Herein, we used fluorescence polarization assays and observed direct transfer for several well-characterized nucleic acid-binding proteins: three-prime repair exonuclease 1, heterogeneous nuclear ribonucleoprotein U, Fem-3-binding factor 2, and MS2 bacteriophage coat protein. For TREX1, the direct transfer mechanism was additionally observed in single-molecule assays, and the data suggest that direct transfer occurs through an unstable ternary intermediate with partially associated polynucleotides. Generally, direct transfer could allow many DNA- and RNA-binding proteins to conduct a one-dimensional search for their target sites. Furthermore, proteins that bind both RNA and DNA might be capable of readily translocating between those ligands.
abstract_zh: 我们此前已证明，多梳抑制复合物2染色质修饰酶能够在RNA与DNA之间直接转移，无需游离酶中间态。模拟研究表明，这种直接转移机制可能普遍为RNA招募蛋白质至染色质所必需，但直接转移能力的普遍性尚不清楚。在此，我们使用荧光偏振实验，观察到几种特征明确的核酸结合蛋白的直接转移：三引物修复外切酶1、异质核核糖核蛋白U、Fem-3结合因子2及MS2噬菌体外壳蛋白。对于TREX1，直接转移机制在单分子实验中亦被观察到，数据表明直接转移通过一个部分结合多核苷酸的不稳定三元中间体发生。总体而言，直接转移可能使许多DNA和RNA结合蛋白能够进行一维搜索以定位其靶位点。此外，同时结合RNA和DNA的蛋白质或许能够轻松地在这些配体之间转移。
